risks.risk: The machine may have electrical faults or fail to boot.

risks.risk: Print quality may be degraded by worn drums, fusers, or transfer belts.
risks.proof: A photo of a freshly printed internal configuration page or color test pattern.

risks.proof: A photo of the 'Meter Count' or 'Counter' screen showing total prints.

risks.risk: Toner levels may be empty or near empty.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and navigating the touch screen menu.
Photo of the 'Counter' screen showing the total page count.
Photo of a printed 'Demo Page' or 'Configuration Page' to verify output quality.
Photo of the consumables status screen showing toner and drum life.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified from the photo. While its functional state is unknown, it can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional/parts) until proof of operation is provided.
